ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure marks the neural pathway starting from the receptor at the skin (Skin), with the signal entering the central neuron region along nerve fibers, and then connecting to the muscle (Muscle) effector by motor neurons. In the illustrated path, only the skin receptor, neurons, a spinal-cord-like reflex pathway, and muscle are shown; it does not show that the signal needs to be transmitted to the frog's brain.
